title: Seoul stocks rebound over 3% on eased AI spending woes
caption:
South Korea's stock market triggered a rare 'sidecar' pause today as semiconductor giants like Samsung and SK hynix surged. The rally followed strong US earnings, which quieted fears that the global AI spending boom was cooling off.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul stocks rebound over 3% on eased AI spending woes
